claims.statement: Approve and reject repeat the exact immutable action and send only expected generation and payload hash through the memory-only CSRF boundary. One stale-token retry replays the identical body. Expired, decided, consumed, superseded, or otherwise nonactionable requests are disabled. Success requires the response and refetched identity, generation, hash, decision, and state to agree; conflict is reported after an attempted authoritative refetch.

limitations: WEB-05 owns the approval queue, exact-action decisions, and Email approval-barrier safety. WEB-06 owns the SPA run timeline and artifact viewer, WEB-07 the narrow semantic tree, and WEB-08 exhaustive accessibility acceptance.

The review surface links to authoritative run, timeline, step, instance, and external-action/receipt API resources. A dedicated in-app timeline and artifact/receipt viewer does not exist until WEB-06.

The browser gate uses the production Vite application and real base FastAPI hierarchy boundary. It overlays deterministic same-origin session, approval, decision-conflict, and run-summary responses because DEL-05 still owns default backend service composition.

The Email zero-call sentence is a current safe-summary proof, not a future execution guarantee. It is withheld unless a complete all-status two-action page, pending bindings, run/action states, attempt counts, and absent receipts/results/completion all agree.
Client controls are operator UX only. The server remains authoritative for identity, authorization, generation, hash binding, one-time use, expiry, conflicts, dispatch, and connector effects.
